questions.text: What sort of stories were collected by the Canterbury Tales written by Geoffrey Chaucer?
questions.explanation: In the years leading up to 1400, Geoffrey Chaucer wrote a series of poems in English about a group of people going to Canterbury on a pilgrimage. The people decided to tell each other stories on the journey, and the poemsdescribe the travellers and some of the stories they told. This collection poems is called The Canterbury Tales.
